title: 商品品类销售
query: 只查询 askdata_mock：统计2026年8月各商品品类的实付金额合计，不额外筛选订单状态。
reason: 结果数值和维度匹配（忽略别名、列顺序、行顺序）

result.sql: SELECT orders_current.category AS "品类", SUM(orders_current.paid_amount) AS "实付金额合计" FROM orders_current WHERE orders_current.order_date BETWEEN '2026-08-01' AND '2026-08-31' GROUP BY orders_current.category ORDER BY "实付金额合计" DESC LIMIT 200
